name: ProsperoWake
description: Native PS5 port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, with USA/PAL support, 4K output, HD textures, PlayStation controls and gameplay improvements.
author: mgoodings
release_notes:
A native PS5 port of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker, with USA and PAL support in one executable.

Changes
- Updated SDL and Aurora while preserving the PS5 renderer integration and game-specific rendering fixes.
- Fixed jump, sprint and rumble to respect the assigned controller and gameplay input locks. Cleared movement input across menu transitions.
- Corrected dialogue stick prompts and kept stick lettering upright in shop, dialogue and menu text.
- Fixed telescope tutorial zoom during subject lock-on and bottom-row clipping in the scripted bird sequence's mask and widescreen bars.
- Fixed PAL accented-name matching and backup-slot selection during save recovery.
- Preserved active settings when saving the configuration fails.
- Streamlined incremental builds and strengthened release packaging checks for dependency sources and binary provenance.

Installation
- Extract PPSA99309/ from ProsperoWake-build-76.zip into /data/homebrew/ on a homebrew-enabled PS5.
- Place your unmodified revision-0 USA (GZLE01) or PAL (GZLP01) game image beside eboot.bin.
- Launch ProsperoWake. Press the touch pad to open options.

ISO, GCM and CISO are supported. Game images and texture packs are not included.

Updating: close the game and preserve your game image, user/ and radv-shader-cache/. USA and PAL saves remain separate.

Notes
- 4K output, widescreen, interpolated 60 fps and HD texture-pack support remain available. Performance varies with resolution, scene and texture pack.
- Optional FX start off; select Enhanced or customize them individually. Ambient occlusion is experimental; cloud shadows are procedural.
- Recommended texture pack: Henriko Magnifico’s Wind Waker 4K.

Built from commit 1e475095ab81818bc57c51ab3946de5ecf1cfb5e. Dependency revisions and executable checksums are included in SOURCE.txt and BUILD_INPUTS.json inside the package.

Based on PS5_SwitchWaker and SwitchWaker, with improvements adapted from Bluewake and Better Wind Waker. Controller artwork by Xelu.
